answer: The canyon design assumes the worst: one operator pretending to be a crowd, and prices admission accordingly. Each epoch, an identity must post a small bond against its own answer; junk or template submissions forfeit it to the graders who caught them. The plume check makes spam a losing trade: a farm submitting a thousand copied answers pays a thousand bonds and funds the very graders who reject them. The crystal turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
